content.value: Find the discharge of water flowing through a pipe 30 cm diameter placed in an inclined position 13 where a venturimeter is inserted, having a throat-diameter of 15 cm. The pressure difference between the main and throat measured by an inverted U-tube manometer in Fig.04. The loss of head between main and the throat is 0.2 times the Kinetic head of the pipe.
